newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks fall in early morning trade.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks fall in early morning trade.

text.p: Tokyo stocks fell in early morning trade on Thursday, weighed down by technical sales in the futures, brokers said.
But the bottom was supported by continuing interest in blue-chip issues and expected launch of new investment trust funds, they also said.
At 0027 GMT, the key Nikkei 225 average was down 167.10 points or 0.78 percent at 21,178.18. Its December futures were 110 points lower at 21,210.
Brokers said the sales in the futures were temporary and stock prices would eventually climb back.
